description:
## What

Pull the entire redirect policy + validation block out of `CrestHttpClient`
into a dedicated class.

## Source to move (from `src/fetcher/crest_http_client.cr`)

Constants:
- `REDIRECT_STATUS_CODES = {301, 302, 303, 307, 308}`

Methods (all currently private):
- `allow_redirect?(source, target, status_code = 302)`
- `same_domain_redirect?(source, target)`
- `subdomain_redirect?(source, target)`
- `external_redirect_allowed?(target, status_code)`
- `permanent_redirect?(status_code)`
- `allowed_domain_redirect?(source, target)`
- `same_registrable_domain?(source, target)`
- `validate_redirect_target(url)`
- `validate_redirect_domain(original_url, source_domain, target_url, status_code = 302)`
- `resolve_redirect_url(redirect_url, original_url)`
- `should_follow_redirect?(response)`
- `extract_redirect_url(response)`
- `extract_redirect_url_from_headers(headers)`
- `transition_domain(from_domain, to_domain)` — kept here, but name is wrong
  (see cleanup ticket)

## Why

- All redirect-related rules are pure functions of `(config, source, target, status)`.
- They have nothing to do with HTTP execution or DNS.
- Co-locating them makes policy changes auditable in one file.
- Unit tests can hit a `RedirectPolicy` directly without standing up the whole
  HTTP client.

## API target

    class Fetcher::CrestHttpClient::RedirectPolicy
      REDIRECT_STATUS_CODES = {301, 302, 303, 307, 308}

      def initialize(@config : RequestConfig, @validator : URLValidator::Service)
      def allow?(source : String, target : String, status_code : Int32 = 302) : Bool
      def validate_target(url : String) : Nil
      def validate_domain(original_url : String, source_domain : String,
                          target_url : String, status_code : Int32 = 302) : Nil
      def resolve(redirect_url : String, original_url : String) : String
      def follow?(response : Crest::Response) : Bool
      def extract_location(response : Crest::Response) : String
    end

## Constraints

- `MissingLocationHeaderError` and `DNSError` raised here must be the same
  classes callers currently catch.
- `extract_redirect_url` used by the spec helper `debug_extract_redirect_url`
  must still work — keep an instance wrapper on `CrestHttpClient` if needed.
- No behavior change: same redirects allowed/blocked, same error messages
  (the `(catseye)` NOTE comments about URL inclusion in messages move with
  the code).

## Done when

- New file exists; `crest_http_client.cr` requires and delegates.
- The 14-ish redirect methods above no longer live in CrestHttpClient.
- `crest_http_client_redirect_spec.cr` and `redirects_psl_spec.cr` pass
  unchanged.
title: Extract RedirectPolicy into src/fetcher/crest_http_client/redirect_policy.cr
